scope: Unchanged Windows SDK brush raster GUI translated into Wasm inside the browser with native Wine base DLLs. Eight stages in EXE/ZIP/catalog modes compare 156160 drawing-area pixels per stage against actual desktop Wine. Includes all 16 source-independent raster operations, solid/color/mono patterns, opaque/transparent hatches, complex clips, reverse extents and atomic source-dependent failure. Universal Windows/DLL compatibility remains incomplete.
oracleReference: Wine 11 desktop x86 macOS; independently captured native SDK brush blits
